name: Cinder
description: a will-o'-the-wisp: a single floating fireball shaped like a teardrop, fist-sized, white-yellow hot core and orange-red flickering edges, cute mischievous face painted inside the flame (two beady black eyes and a grin), a wisp of smoke and a few sparks trailing behind it, heavy ink outline

poses.stand: floating in the air, its flame tip flickering upward
poses.windup: puffed up larger, core flaring white-hot with a thick cyan glow rim, eyes wide and grin huge, held still for a Cuphead wind-up beat before it lunges
poses.lunge: stretched forward to the right, flame streaming back, mid-lunge
poses.struck: jolted, eyes crossed, sparks flying off
poses.popped: bursting apart into a scatter of tiny sparks and a puff of smoke

idle.action: floats in place, its flame flickering and wobbling, blinking its eyes

move.action: leans forward and drifts toward the right, its flame streaming backward, staying in the same spot in the frame

windup.action: swells up and HOLDS the puffed glowing wind-up pose with a bright rim, no forward motion yet

attack.action: lunges forward to the right in a short pop-charge, then settles

hurt.action: is struck, jerks and sheds sparks, then recovers

die.action: puffs up and pops into a burst of sparks and smoke

prompts.standFromText: Paint {description}. Seen from the side, small and centered in the frame with lots of empty space around it. It is a ball of fire that floats in the air by itself. {style} {background}
prompts.pose: Image 1 is {description}. Show this exact same object, the same design, {action}. Keep its shape, colors, size and position in the frame and the painterly art style of image 1. {background}

style: Hand-inked 2D arcade character like Hollow Knight and Cuphead: heavy warm near-black outline (#140B0D), flat two-tone cel colour (base + one shadow), one thin rim of hellfire light, a readable silhouette at 48 px, no soft airbrush, no gradients beyond two tones, no pure black #000000, side view facing right
background: Plain flat pure green background (#00ff00), no floor, no shadow, no scenery, even studio lighting.
negative: photorealistic, 3d render, soft airbrush, gradient shading, watercolor wash, pure black outline, text, watermark, busy background, extra limbs, blurry, low contrast silhouette, camera movement, zoom, pan
